title: Draft plugin protocol v1alpha1: plugin catalog
description: The signed plugin catalog published as plugins.json beside index.json in a tool-index release, with the Sigstore bundle plugins.json.sigstore.json over the SHA-256 of the exact plugins.json bytes, signed by the same pinned tool-index release identity. Shape only: crates/oyzu-plugin-protocol also checks the rules JSON Schema cannot express (content_digest, sort order and uniqueness, references between members, root digest uniqueness within a package, version/major agreement, matcher depth and size, freshness window and serial succession). The catalog supplies candidate references, release metadata and detection observations; it grants no authority, names no plugin as a dependency of another and assigns no evidence strength.

serial.description: Envelope: the tool-index release serial stamped on index.json in the same release, re-signs included. A client refuses a serial lower than the last verified catalog's, an equal one with different bytes, or a higher one generated earlier.

generated_at.description: Envelope: when the release workflow stamped this document.

expires_at.description: Envelope: the document must not be used for current eligibility after this time. Later than generated_at and at most 31 days after it.

content_digest.description: Semantic identity: sha256 of the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of content. A re-signed catalog with the same content keeps the same digest, so caches keyed by catalog semantics stay valid when only the envelope changes.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC time in whole seconds, the only accepted spelling.

packageId.description: A canonical package identity <publisher>/<name>, as recorded in the oyzu.lock plugin selection.

shortUses.description: A logical uses reference without a major selector: <package>/<profile>.

authority.description: The naming authority whose short-name bindings this catalog publishes: oyzu for the official public catalog. Package identities are the publishers' own; an organization catalog lists oyzu/go under that identity.

packages.description: Canonical packages and their releases, sorted by package id.

references.description: Logical uses references, sorted by reference. Several references may share one package.

withdrawals.description: Withdrawn or revoked releases, sorted by package then version. A withdrawn release is not also listed under releases, and a root digest names one release of a package across releases and withdrawals. Absence from the catalog is unavailability, never withdrawal.

releases.description: Admitted releases, sorted by semantic version precedence, oldest first, versions unique.

major.description: The major component of version; the selector @v<major> and an adopted major match it.

preview.description: A preview release needs deliberate selection and is excluded from stable resolution, latest stable and updates. A semantic-version prerelease is always a preview.

protocol_generations.description: Common protocol generations the release speaks, sorted and unique; core needs one of them.

roles.description: Role contracts with the core features the release requires, sorted by role.

features.description: Required core features, sorted and unique.

profiles.description: Profiles the release registers, as its manifest does, sorted by name.

root_digest.description: Digest of the immutable OCI release root, the value recorded as release in oyzu.lock.

platforms.description: Native payloads, sorted by os, arch, abi; one per os/arch/abi.

routes.description: Approved acquisition routes for the release root, at most one of each type. Every route yields the same root digest.

min_platform.description: Minimum OS release, such as 11.0 for macOS or 2.17 for glibc.

manifest_digest.description: The platform's OCI manifest in the release root.

size.description: Payload archive bytes, at most 1 GiB.

reference.description: <registry>/<repository>@<root_digest>. Packages of publisher oyzu, and only those, use ghcr.io/oyzuai/plugins/<name>. Mirrors are not listed here: they come from organization route configuration and preserve the root digest.

url.description: An approved HTTPS location of the release graph as an OCI image layout archive, verified by root_digest. No credentials, query or fragment.

tested.description: Tested core and platform combinations, sorted by core version. Untested combinations are unknown, not unsupported.

core.description: The exact Oyzu engine version tested.

platforms.description: Platforms of this release tested with that core, sorted and unique.

status.description: supported: within its support statement. deprecated: still eligible, with a replacement or end date. unsupported: eligible only where policy accepts unsupported releases. Withdrawal is separate.

ends.description: End of support, required when deprecated.

reference.description: The logical uses reference users configure, such as go/app.

package.description: The canonical package the reference binds to; it must be listed under packages.

profile.description: The profile within that package. At least one release registers it with this role.

role.description: The registered core role, the type filter of plugin search.

detection.description: One mapping from bounded project observations to a logical uses candidate. The author describes observations only; core assigns their evidence class and applies role rules.

uses.description: A logical reference listed under references. Detection never selects a major, a direct source or a release.

matcher.description: Bounded matcher over one candidate directory: at most 32 nodes, nesting depth at most 4, and the matcher as a whole requires a positive observation (an exclusion alone matches nothing).

file.description: An exact marker file name present in the candidate directory, compared case-sensitively.

fieldPredicate.description: A bounded structural field of a supported manifest format, read by core's own parser. Exactly one test: present, equals or prefix. A file that is missing or does not parse does not match.

format.description: json and toml address object keys; go-mod addresses the single-valued directives module, go and toolchain.

path.description: Object keys from the document root; no wildcards, indexes or expressions.

root_preimage.description: Exact base64 OCI root bytes, at most 1 MiB decoded. Required for a local Preview withdrawal; its digest, immutable marker and exact package/version are checked by the Preview authority owner.

kind.description: withdrawn: retracted by its maintainer; not selectable and locked selections must be updated. revoked: content trust is withdrawn as well; installed copies must not run.

replacement.description: A suggested release of the same package. Advice only; it never changes a lock.

withdrawal.description: Release-level: it applies to every profile and platform of the release.
